added_failures_note: Unmeasured: the source manifest baseline_suite and after_suite fields are empty and the source live node records both as null; the source brief explicitly left its suite unarmed. No baseline/head suite logs exist from which to derive a numeric delta. This is not a measured zero.

assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:27: Recomputed array counts differing from separately stored JSON counts fail; this guards archive consistency, not independently the physical correctness of either capture.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:28: Zeroing a connected mask AND its recorded count defeats only the consistency assertion, then fails the positive-stage check; source negative-control.log demonstrates this exact case with EXIT=1.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:29: A connected cell outside material intersected with closed fails the subset assertion.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:30: A recorded polish shift at least one lattice spacing fails; the gate trusts this archived metadata rather than recomputing polish.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:31-32: Axis-cell flags disagreeing with saved material/closed arrays fail; these are consistency assertions rather than independent admission truth tests.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:33: Passing only a lattice-sized state or metadata saying so fails; actual state size is not recomputed by this gate.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:34: A nonsquare transpose or reshape inconsistent with the saved axes fails; a square transpose alone is not detected by shape, and the independent polisher check is in the producer.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:57-62: Replacing the receipt assignment with support cardinality rather than active_set_mask_differences fails the source AST provenance assertion.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:82: An SVG of 300000 bytes or more fails.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:86: A missing count label fails; it checks presence anywhere in SVG text rather than stage-label correspondence.
assertion_analysis.render_support.py:211: Clipped or overlapping text fails via the existing render_panels checker.
assertion_analysis.render_support.py:240: Single-precision rendering/polishing fails the x64 check.
assertion_analysis.render_support.py:42: A saved field shape inconsistent with radius-height axes fails.
assertion_analysis.trace_support.py:176: A production connected mask with zero cells fails after operands have been archived.
assertion_analysis.trace_support.py:58: Two host return captures are required; removing either original-material or rescue read would fail this assertion.
assertion_analysis.trace_support.py:64: Disabling double precision before measurement makes this fail.
assertion_analysis.trace_support.py:96: A nonconverged stationary polish or axis displacement of at least one lattice pitch fails; this guards a repeated field-orientation mistake.

assertion_independence: No assertion calls a function with an expected return value and then compares the return to that same supplied value. Several assertions compare two archived representations of the same measurement; these are explicitly credited only as consistency checks. Main evidence is the production capture, receipt wiring, retained raw arrays and a control that changes both mask and count.
call_sites_note: No application production caller invokes these new standalone prototype scripts; their CLI main functions invoke the production seams listed separately.

figure_review.method: Exact committed SVG blobs rendered with ImageMagick convert at density 140 to 1400-pixel PNGs and visually inspected. Labels are readable and do not collide; nonempty displaced support on 146 remains visible above limiter.

justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-support-mask-collapse.html:3-24 answers the actual investigation by demonstrating that zero counts changed entries and no captured support-construction stage empties.
justifications.reuse: Capability searches across scripts/prototypes/diiid_forward_convergence, scripts/prototypes/diiid_stopping_rule, scripts/prototypes/diiid_axis_selection and nova/media found no host-local support-stage dump or capture validator; trace_support.py:27 wraps the production owner and render_support.py:22-32 reuses existing geometry, plotting and text-validation mechanisms.
